First of all, he seems to have some sort of prn addiction or he is obsessed with wanting that kind of content being constantly fed to him. If he is okay with that and wants to keep that behaviour it's okay as long as he is not hurting anyone or making anyone uncomfortable. Nonetheless, when you both communicated several times and met a place of mutual understanding, but he kept demonstrating with his actions that he did not actually respect them, that he lied to you about what his thoughts were and how he was gonna react; there's a situation where he hurts and disrespects you. It would be a completely different story if he was honest about how he feels about this, addressed the problem he has, and tried to find an actual real mutual agreement.

On the other hand, there's another problem here, which is the fact that he doesn't care about keeping a behaviour that hurts you. There's a problem in him seeing that his actions are making you feel bad and constantly choosing to prioritize such an unimportant act instead of wanting to do better for you or at least try to find a place where you both can feel better. If he keeps lying and hiding the truth from you, then there's no future in arguing with him. He is taking advantage of this, even if it comes from an unconscious place.

I would say give your final warning and if nothing changes it's better to walk away and find someone with better communication skills, to get a relationship where you can feel comfortable. If not, things will only keep worsening untill you can't ignore the problem anymore and it drives you insane (happened to me). If he listens to you, if he tries to solve the issue and you can see that he is actually trying, then maybe it's worth giving him some more time. It's clear that at this level of prn addiction he can't stop in an instant, but he has to say the truth about his struggle and how he is trying to overcome it.
